title: Objectwise finite-field compactness with caller-supplied coproducts
statement: Let D be a finite-field datum, ℓ a prime different from D.p, and X a separated finite-type scheme over D.k. Let Λ be one of the six localizing-admissible condensed coefficients. Let S be the constructible finite-Tor property, which is essentially small by Noetherian smallness. For every coproduct structure in universe u+1 on L=Loc(S), each K in L whose underlying object belongs to S is compact for that coproduct structure. No assertion is made for arbitrary fields or for arbitrary coefficient rings.

source.place: Compactness paragraph; passage from a small skeleton to each constructible finite-Tor object

proof.text: Finite type over a field makes X compact and locally Noetherian. Apply small_bounded_constant_models from the existing Noetherian smallness module, and restrict essential smallness to S using the inclusion into bounded constructible objects. Choose a small category equivalent to S. Its skeleton has a representative of every isomorphism class, and two isomorphic representatives are equal by skeletalness and full faithfulness.
Reorder the six alternatives of the admissibility predicate and apply finite-field internal compactness. Proof irrelevance identifies its coproduct structure with the one supplied by the caller.

For each representative, the defining intersection for the localizing closure gives membership because the representative belongs to S. Choose a representative isomorphic to K. Lift this isomorphism to the full localizing subcategory. Convert compactness to BrownRepresentability.IsCompactObj, transport it along the lifted isomorphism, and convert back. This includes a zero object and empty coproducts.

proof_origin.note: Valid finite-field specialization only; preserves all geometric and coefficient hypotheses of the compactness input.

lean.statement:
theorem brownHypotheses_finiteField_object_compactness
    (D : WeilConjectures.FiniteFieldDatum.{u}) (ℓ : ℕ) [Fact ℓ.Prime]
    (hℓ : ℓ ≠ D.p) (X : Scheme.{u}) [X.Over (Spec (.of D.k))]
    [IsSeparated (X ↘ Spec (.of D.k))]
    [LocallyOfFiniteType (X ↘ Spec (.of D.k))]
    [QuasiCompact (X ↘ Spec (.of D.k))]
    (Λ : Sheaf (coherentTopology Profinite.{u}) Ab.{u + 1})
    [MonObj Λ] [IsCommMonObj Λ]
    (hΛ : IsLocalizingAdmissibleCoefficient ℓ Λ)
    (hSums : HasCoproducts.{u + 1}
      (localizingClosureProEtale Λ X).FullSubcategory)
    (K : (localizingClosureProEtale Λ X).FullSubcategory)
    (hK : constantModelBoundedConstructible Λ X K.obj ∧
      DerivedCategory.finiteTorAmplitude _ K.obj) :
    @IsCompactObject _ _ _ hSums K
